# Low poly trees — Polybuild

Source: https://store.godotengine.org/asset/polybuild/low-poly-trees/

The Godot Asset Store lists this pack as MIT licensed. The downloaded archive contains four GLB files and no separate licence file or copyright year. Attribution: Polybuild. The meshes are repositioned, scaled and recoloured at runtime by `scripts/main.gd`; the four GLB files are otherwise unchanged.

Downloaded 29 September 2026. Source ZIP SHA-256: `0D65F6D033FE0F218863A1E201CBAD20A458DFADE1A59BE91222500CAC8404C0`.
